summary: PLATE 0.8.3 -- safe migrate-docs-namespace command, and Windows gh/git calls no longer flash console windows while babysitting.

entries.surface: docs/migration/, gh plate CLI, MCP server
entries.migration_impact: Existing PLATE adopters can now safely migrate docs from docs/ to docs/plate/ namespace using the new `gh plate migrate-docs-namespace` command (dry-run by default). The migration guide no longer recommends the destructive `--strategy force` path that overwrites AGENTS.md. The command uses git mv, preserves customizations, rewrites references, and is idempotent.
entries.agent_notes: When migrating PLATE docs to docs/plate/ namespace, use `gh plate migrate-docs-namespace` (or `plate_migrate_docs_namespace` MCP tool, or `python -m plate_core.cli migrate-docs-namespace`). Always dry-run first. Never use `gh plate import-payload --strategy force` for migration as it overwrites customized files and leaves duplicates. The migration command preserves AGENTS.md, SPEC.md, CURRENT.md, and all product documentation, only moving PLATE-owned directories and files. It rewrites references in a selected set of repository files (workflows, issue templates, agent instructions, skills.yml, bootstrap scripts—see REFERENCE_FILES in migrate_docs_namespace.py); protected files (AGENTS.md, SPEC.md, CURRENT.md) are scanned but not modified, with stale references reported as manual follow-up items. All changes (moves and reference updates) are staged for atomic commit.
migration_guidance: 1. If you've already adopted PLATE and have docs at docs/ root with product docs, you need to migrate to docs/plate/.
2. Install plate-core v0.8.3+ and the gh plate extension: `gh extension install akasper/gh-plate`
3. Dry-run first: `gh plate migrate-docs-namespace` (reviews the plan without changes)
4. Apply if the plan looks good: `gh plate migrate-docs-namespace --apply`
5. The command moves PLATE doc dirs (adr/, audits/, bootstrap/, design/, marketing/, migration/, research/, wiki/) to docs/plate/, preserves AGENTS.md/SPEC.md/CURRENT.md, and updates path references.
6. Commit the changes: `git commit -m 'Migrate PLATE docs to docs/plate/ namespace'`

entries.surface: gh plate CLI, MCP server, plate_core subprocess
entries.migration_impact: No repository migration. Windows agents that babysit a PR no longer flash focus-stealing console windows on each poll. A watcher started with --watch stops when its parent process exits, or with `gh plate pr babysit --stop`.
entries.agent_notes: On Windows, do not spawn gh or git with shell=True or a bare subprocess call. Use plate_core.procutil.run_hidden so CREATE_NO_WINDOW is set and text is decoded as UTF-8. Babysit --watch writes .agentic/babysit/babysit-<owner>-<repo>-<pr>.pid and exits when the parent process dies. Stop a leftover watcher with `gh plate pr babysit --stop` rather than leaving a detached poll loop running. Copilot CLI sessions hit the same gh/git console spawn.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core and gh-plate to the release that contains this fix (targeted at 0.8.3).
2. Stop any watcher left from an older build: `gh plate pr babysit --stop`, or taskkill the leftover python.exe.
3. Start watches with `gh plate pr babysit <pr> --watch`. Stop them with `gh plate pr babysit --stop`.
